chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

When the child of a believer is taken, and Allah knows best what the servant said, He asks the angels: 'Have you taken the child of so-and-so, the believer?' They say: 'Yes, our Lord.' He says: 'Then what did My believing servant say?' They say: 'He praised You, our Lord, and said words of istirjaʿ.' Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'Build for him a house in Paradise, and name it the House of Praise.'

key_terms.اسْتَرْجَعَ: he said the words of return to Allah in calamity
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer; the faithful servant of Allah
key_terms.بَيْتَ الْحَمْدِ: the House of Praise, a house in Paradise named for the servant’s praise
key_terms.حَمِدَكَ: he praised You; expressed gratitude to Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a believer who shows patience when a child dies?
ai.summary: This hadith describes Allah's mercy toward the believer who responds to the loss of a child with praise and patient return to Him. It teaches that such gratitude and sabr in calamity are rewarded with a house in Paradise called Bayt al-Hamd.
